symbols.name: DecodeLastRuneInString
symbols.summary: The last rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".

symbols.name: DecodeRune
symbols.summary: The first rune of b and its size; (RuneError, 0) for empty b.

symbols.name: DecodeRuneAt
symbols.summary: The rune starting at byte i of s and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).

symbols.name: DecodeRuneIn
symbols.summary: The rune starting at byte i of b and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).

symbols.name: DecodeRuneInString
symbols.summary: The first rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".

symbols.name: EncodeRune
symbols.summary: The UTF-8 encoding of r (RuneError's if r is invalid).

symbols.name: FullRune
symbols.summary: True if b begins with a complete (possibly invalid) encoding.

symbols.name: RuneCount
symbols.summary: Number of runes in b (each invalid byte counts as one).

symbols.name: RuneCountInString
symbols.summary: Number of runes in s (each invalid byte counts as one).

symbols.name: RuneLen
symbols.summary: Bytes needed to encode r, or -1 if r is not a valid code point.

symbols.name: RuneStart
symbols.summary: True if c can start an encoded rune (is not a continuation byte).

symbols.name: Valid
symbols.summary: True if b is entirely valid UTF-8.

symbols.name: ValidRune
symbols.summary: True if r can be encoded (not a surrogate, at most U+10FFFF).

symbols.name: ValidString
symbols.summary: True if s is entirely valid UTF-8.

namespaces.name: unsafe
namespaces.summary: Raw memory access and foreign calls without any checks; importing it needs the `unsafe` capability in the manifest.

symbols.name: AddrOf
symbols.summary: AddrOf returns the data word of the `any` value x.

symbols.name: CString
symbols.summary: CString copies the NUL-terminated C string at addr.

symbols.name: CallFunc
symbols.summary: CallFunc calls the C function at addr with up to 8 integer arguments and returns its integer result.

symbols.name: ReadBytes
symbols.summary: ReadBytes copies n bytes starting at addr.

symbols.name: ReadFloat
symbols.summary: ReadFloat reads a float of size bytes (4 or 8) at addr.

symbols.name: ReadInt
symbols.summary: ReadInt reads a signed integer of size bytes (1, 2, 4, 8) at addr.

symbols.name: ReadUint
symbols.summary: ReadUint reads an unsigned integer of size bytes at addr.

symbols.name: TypeOf
symbols.summary: TypeOf returns the type word of the `any` value x.

symbols.name: WriteBytes
symbols.summary: WriteBytes copies b to addr.

symbols.name: WriteInt
symbols.summary: WriteInt writes v as an integer of size bytes at addr.

namespaces.name: uuid
namespaces.summary: UUIDs: random version 4 values and validation.

symbols.name: IsValid
symbols.summary: IsValid reports whether s is a UUID in canonical form.

symbols.name: New
